atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.85, "Coil Threshold", 0.5, 0.98, 0.01)
vovRiseBars = input(3, "VoV Rise Bars", 1, 10, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
highestA = highest(a, coilLookback)
coilLoad = 1 - (a / max(highestA, 0.0001))
rng = high - low
highestR = highest(rng, coilLookback)
rangeCoil = 1 - (rng / max(highestR, 0.0001))
atrMean = sma(a, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(a, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / max(atrMean, 0.0001)
vovPast = vov[vovRiseBars]
vovRising = vov > vovPast
chg = abs(close - close[1])
sumAbs = 0.0
for i = 0 to 19 {
    sumAbs = sumAbs + chg[i]
}
effMove = abs(close - close[predictLen])
predictability = effMove / max(sumAbs, 0.0001)
warm = bar_index > coilLookback
loaded = warm and coilLoad > coilThresh and rangeCoil > coilThresh and vovRising
loadedPred = loaded and predictability > 0.35
loadedUnpred = loaded and predictability <= 0.35
buySig = loaded[1] and rng > a * releaseMult and close > open and predictability > 0.35
sellSig = loaded[1] and rng > a * releaseMult and close < open and predictability > 0.35
coneBase = 0.8 + vov * 8.0
coneClamped = max(0.6, min(2.2, coneBase))
coneSize = coneClamped * markerSize
sphereBase = 0.9 + vov * 10.0
sphereClamped = max(0.6, min(2.2, sphereBase))
sphereSize = sphereClamped * markerSize

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if loaded { bgcolor("#1a2b4a") }
if loadedUnpred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Coiled Unpredictable", "sphere", "#888888", sphereSize, 0, "separate") }
if loadedPred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Coiled Predictable", "sphere", "#22ddff", sphereSize, 1, "separate") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Release Long 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Release Short 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSize, 1, "separate") }
plot(coilLoad, "CoilLoad", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#ff66cc", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability 3D", "scatter", "#ff66cc", "separate", 1)

// Siege Session Break Multi-Timeframe Model
// AUDIT: Session extremes via sliding highest/lowest — validated vs TradingView
// AUDIT: HTF via confirmed security("1h") — closed bucket only, never repaints
// AUDIT: Buffer/Stop in fixed price ticks (tick = 0.01) — deterministic, no ATR substitution

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length Bars", 10, 500, 1)
htfLook = input(3, "1h Confirmation Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
bufTicks = input(2, "Structure Break Buffer Ticks", 0, 50, 1)
stopTicks = input(30, "Hard Stop Ticks", 1, 500, 1)
minQual = input(60, "Min Structure Quality", 0, 100, 5)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
prevHigh = sessHigh[1]
prevLow = sessLow[1]

hHigh = security("1h", high)
hLow = security("1h", low)
hClose = security("1h", close)

hClose1 = hClose[1]
hClose2 = hClose[2]
hRange = hHigh - hLow
hRange1 = hRange[1]
htfSwingHigh = highest(hHigh, htfLook)[1]
htfSwingLow = lowest(hLow, htfLook)[1]

tickPx = 0.01
bufferPx = bufTicks * tickPx
stopDist = stopTicks * tickPx

bullStruct = hClose > htfSwingHigh + bufferPx
bearStruct = hClose < htfSwingLow - bufferPx

up1 = hClose > hClose1
up2 = hClose1 > hClose2
dn1 = hClose < hClose1
dn2 = hClose1 < hClose2
trend2 = (up1 and up2) or (dn1 and dn2)
expand = hRange > hRange1
denom = hRange + 0.000000001
posInRange = (hClose - hLow) / denom
edgeClose = posInRange >= 0.75 or posInRange <= 0.25
quality = (trend2 ? 50 : 0) + (expand ? 30 : 0) + (edgeClose ? 20 : 0)
qualOk = quality >= minQual
conf = quality / 100

var entryPx = 0.0
var stopLvl = 0.0
var curPos = 0.0

longStopHit = curPos == 1 and low <= stopLvl
shortStopHit = curPos == -1 and high >= stopLvl
oppExitLong = curPos == 1 and close < prevLow
oppExitShort = curPos == -1 and close > prevHigh

buySig = close > prevHigh and bullStruct and qualOk and curPos != 1
sellSig = close < prevLow and bearStruct and qualOk and curPos != -1

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    stopLvl := close - stopDist
    curPos := 1
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    stopLvl := close + stopDist
    curPos := -1
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longStopHit or oppExitLong {
    model.longExit("siege")
    curPos := 0
    entryPx := 0.0
    stopLvl := close
}
if shortStopHit or oppExitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    curPos := 0
    entryPx := 0.0
    stopLvl := close
}

plotStop = curPos != 0 ? stopLvl : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(plotStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
